summary.zh: 管理站点内容与集合条目
summary.en: Manage site content and CMS items

description.zh: 读取站点、页面与 CMS 集合，创建和更新内容条目。适合批量维护博客或产品页文案。首次连接在浏览器登录 Webflow 授权并选择站点。
description.en: Read sites, pages, and CMS collections, and create or update items. Useful for bulk-editing blog posts or product page copy. Sign in to Webflow and pick a site on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Webflow 并选择站点
authHint.en: Sign in to Webflow and choose a site on first connect
